But the phrase "in the year 2026" indicates the year. So maybe they want to travel on November 16, 2026. That seems plausible.

We can at least compute cost and check balance. Then inform user that we can't book because no booking function. But we can provide cost and balance info. So we should call get_flight_cost and get_credit_card_balance. Then respond accordingly.
